name: sihl-workpulse
description: SIHL workPulse - Enterprise Work Management Platform

scripts.dev: npm run build:db && npm run dev:apps
scripts.dev:apps: concurrently -n api,web -c blue,green "npm run dev -w apps/api" "npm run dev -w apps/web"
scripts.build:db: npm run db:generate && npm run build -w packages/db
scripts.build: npm run build:db && npm run build -w apps/api && npm run build -w apps/web
scripts.lint: npm run lint -w apps/api && npm run lint -w apps/web
scripts.typecheck: npm run typecheck -w apps/api && npm run typecheck -w apps/web && npm run typecheck -w packages/shared-types
scripts.db:migrate: npm run assert-target && prisma migrate dev --schema packages/db/prisma/schema.prisma
scripts.db:migrate:deploy: npm run assert-target && prisma migrate deploy --schema packages/db/prisma/schema.prisma
